description: Profile of any EVM address across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon in one call: total USD value and top holdings, transactions sent per chain, profile (fresh, light, active, heavy or bot, contract), EIP-7702 delegation, ENS name and an OFAC sanctions check. Use for counterparty checks, airdrop and sybil screening, or knowing who an agent is paying.
